description: This file defines a base class for reminder tests in an Orleans-based testing environment. It includes utility methods for managing reminders, performing assertions, and handling retries, as well as several test scenarios for reminder behavior such as start, stop, list operations, failure, and churn testing.

classes.name: ReminderTests_Base
classes.description: A base class providing common utilities and test operations for reminder-related tests in Orleans.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources by erasing the reminder table via a grain proxy.

methods.name: Test_Reminders_Basic_StopByRef
methods.description: Tests starting and stopping reminders by reference, including verification of removal.

methods.name: Test_Reminders_Basic_ListOps
methods.description: Tests listing reminders and verifying their presence and counters.

methods.name: Test_Reminders_1J_MultiGrainMultiReminders
methods.description: Tests multiple grains with reminders, including starting, stopping, and silo addition.

methods.name: Test_Reminders_ReminderNotFound
methods.description: Verifies behavior when requesting a non-existent reminder.

methods.name: PerGrainMultiReminderTestChurn
methods.description: Performs churn testing with multiple reminders on a grain, including start/stop sequences.

methods.name: PerGrainFailureTest
methods.description: Tests reminder failure and recovery behavior on a grain.

methods.name: PerGrainMultiReminderTest
methods.description: Performs multiple reminder start/stop sequences and verifies firing counts.

methods.name: PerCopyGrainFailureTest
methods.description: Tests reminder behavior on a copy grain, including start, stop, and counter verification.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time as a string.

methods.name: AssertIsInRange
methods.description: Asserts that a value is within a specified range, with detailed logging.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetries
methods.description: Executes a function with retries, handling specific exceptions.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetriesStop
methods.description: Executes a stop function with retries.

methods.name: HandleError
methods.description: Handles exceptions during retries, with logging and delay for retryable exceptions.
